title.zh: 卷三十三 志第十四: 禮六 原廟 朝謁儀 朝拜儀 別廟
title.en: Volume 33 Treatises 14: Rites 6 - Original Shrines, Invocation Ceremonies, Pilgrimages, Other Temples
title.raw: 卷三十三 志第十四: 禮六 原廟 朝謁儀 朝拜儀 別廟 Volume 33 Treatises 14: Rites 6 - Original Shrines, Invocation Ceremonies, Pilgrimages, Other Temples

sentences.zh: 太宗天會二年，立大聖皇帝廟于西京。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianhui under Emperor Taizong, a temple to the Great Sage Emperor was established in the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In Taizong's second Tianhui year, a temple to the Great Sage Emperor was erected in the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 熙宗天眷二年九月，又以上京慶元宮為太祖皇帝原廟。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the second year of Tianjuan under Emperor Xizong, the Qingyuan Palace in the Upper Capital was likewise made the original temple of Emperor Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Xizong's second Tianjuan year, the Qingyuan Palace in the Upper Capital was also designated as the original shrine of Emperor Taizu.

sentences.zh: 皇統七年，有司奏：「慶元宮門舊日景暉，殿日辰居，似非廟中之名，今宜改殿名曰世德。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Huangtong, the relevant offices memorialized: "Formerly the gate of Qingyuan Palace was called Jinghui and the hall Chenju—names that seem unsuitable for a temple; the hall should now be renamed Shide."
translations.idiomatic: In Huangtong 7, the responsible offices reported: "The Qingyuan Palace gate was once called Jinghui and its hall Chenju—names ill suited to an ancestral shrine. The hall should now be renamed Shide."

sentences.zh: 」是歲，東京禦容殿成。

translations.literal: That year, the Imperial Portrait Hall in the Eastern Capital was completed.
translations.idiomatic: That same year, the Imperial Portrait Hall in the Eastern Capital was completed.

sentences.zh: 世宗大定二年十二月，詔以「會寧府國家興王之地，宜就慶元宮址建正殿九間，仍其舊號，以時薦享」。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the second year of Dading under Emperor Shizong, an edict stated: "Huining Prefecture is the place where the state rose to kingship; a main hall of nine bays should be built on the site of Qingyuan Palace, retaining its former name, with seasonal offerings."
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Shizong's second Dading year, an edict declared: "Huining Prefecture is where the dynasty first rose to kingship. A main hall of nine bays should be built on the Qingyuan Palace site, keeping its former name, with offerings presented each season."

sentences.zh: 海陵天德四年，有司言：「燕京興建太廟，複立原廟。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tiande under Prince Hailing, the relevant offices stated: "The Grand Ancestral Temple is being built in Yanjing, and original temples are to be re-established."
translations.idiomatic: In Hailing's fourth Tiande year, the responsible offices reported: "With the Grand Ancestral Temple rising in Yanjing, original shrines should be re-established as well."

sentences.zh: 三代以前無原廟制，至漢惠帝始置廟于長安渭北，薦以時果，其後又置於豐、沛，不聞享薦之禮。

translations.literal: Before the Three Dynasties there was no system of original temples; it was only under Emperor Huidi of Han that temples were first set up north of the Wei River at Chang'an, with seasonal fruits offered; later they were also set up at Feng and Pei, but no rites of offering and sacrifice are recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Before the Three Dynasties there was no institution of original shrines. Emperor Huidi of Han was the first to establish temples north of the Wei at Chang'an, offering seasonal fruits; later shrines were also set up at Feng and Pei, but no full rites of sacrifice and offering are recorded for them.

sentences.zh: 今兩都告享宜止於燕京所建原廟行事。

translations.literal: At present, report offerings at the two capitals should be conducted only at the original temple built in Yanjing.
translations.idiomatic: For the present, report offerings at the two capitals should be performed only at the original shrine built in Yanjing.

sentences.zh: 」於是，名其宮曰衍慶，殿曰聖武，門曰崇聖。

translations.literal: Thereupon the palace was named Yansqing, the hall Shengwu, and the gate Chongsheng.
translations.idiomatic: The palace was then named Yansqing, its hall Shengwu, and its gate Chongsheng.

sentences.zh: 大定二年，以睿宗禦容奉遷衍慶宮。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dading, the imperial portrait of Emperor Ruizong was reverently transferred to Yansqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 2, the imperial portrait of Emperor Ruizong was ceremonially moved to Yansqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 五年，會甯府太祖廟成，有司言宜以禦容安置。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, when the temple of Emperor Taizu in Huining Prefecture was completed, the relevant offices stated that the imperial portrait should be installed there.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, once the temple of Emperor Taizu at Huining was finished, the responsible offices advised that the imperial portrait should be installed there.

sentences.zh: 先是，衍慶宮藏太祖禦容十有二：法服一、立容一、戎衣一、佩弓矢一、坐容二、巾服一，舊在會寧府安置；

translations.literal: Previously, Yansqing Palace held twelve imperial portraits of Emperor Taizu: one in court robes, one standing, one in military dress, one with bow and arrows, two seated, one in cap and robe—formerly kept at Huining Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Yansqing Palace held twelve imperial portraits of Emperor Taizu: one in court robes, one standing, one in military dress, one bearing bow and arrows, two seated, and one in cap and robe—all formerly kept at Huining;

sentences.zh: 半身容二，春衣容一、巾而衣紅者二，舊在中都禦容殿安置，今皆在此。

translations.literal: two half-length portraits, one in spring dress, and two in caps with red garments—formerly kept in the Imperial Portrait Hall at the Central Capital; all were now here.
translations.idiomatic: two half-length portraits, one in spring dress, and two in caps with red garments had been kept in the Imperial Portrait Hall at the Central Capital; all were now gathered here.

sentences.zh: 詔以便服容一，遣官奉安，擇日啟行。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that one portrait in informal dress be reverently installed, officials dispatched, and a day chosen for departure.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed that one informal-dress portrait be ceremonially installed, with officials dispatched and a departure day chosen.

sentences.zh: 前一日，夙興，告廟，用酒饌，差奏告官一員，以所差使充，進請禦署祝板。

translations.literal: On the previous day, rising at dawn, they reported to the temple with wine and food, appointed one announcing officer—the dispatched envoy serving in that role—and submitted a request for the imperially signed prayer board.
translations.idiomatic: On the eve of departure, at dawn they reported to the temple with wine and food, appointed one announcing officer (the dispatched envoy serving in that role), and submitted a request for the imperially signed prayer board.

sentences.zh: 其日質明，有司設龍車于衍慶宮門外少西，東向。

translations.literal: At dawn that day, the relevant offices set out the dragon carriage slightly west of the outer gate of Yansqing Palace, facing east.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn that day, the responsible offices set the dragon carriage slightly west of Yansqing Palace's outer gate, facing east.

sentences.zh: 宰執率百官公服詣本宮殿下，班立，再拜。

translations.literal: The chief councillors led all officials in formal dress to the forecourt of the palace, where they formed ranks and bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The chief councillors led all officials in court dress to the palace forecourt, where they formed ranks and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 班首升殿，跪上香、奠酒，教坊樂作，少退，再拜。

translations.literal: The lead of the rank ascended the hall, knelt to offer incense and present wine; the Court Music Office performed; he withdrew slightly and bowed twice again.
translations.idiomatic: The lead of the rank ascended, knelt to offer incense and wine while the Court Music Office played, withdrew slightly, and bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 班首降階復位，陪位官皆再拜。

translations.literal: The lead descended the steps and returned to his place; all accompanying officials bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The lead descended and returned to his station; all accompanying officials bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 奉送使副率太祝捧禦容匣出，宰執以下分左右前導，出衍慶宮門外，俟禦容匣升車，百官上馬後從，旗幟甲馬錦衣人等分左右導，香輿扇等前行。

translations.literal: The chief and deputy envoys of the escort led the chief invoker in bearing out the casket of the imperial portrait; the chief councillors and those below guided left and right; outside the gate of Yansqing Palace they waited until the casket was placed on the carriage; all officials mounted and followed; banners, armored horsemen, brocade-clad attendants, and others guided left and right; the incense carriage, fans, and the like went ahead.
translations.idiomatic: The chief and deputy escort envoys led the chief invoker bearing the portrait casket out; chief councillors and the rest guided on either side. Outside Yansqing's gate they waited until the casket was lifted onto the carriage; officials mounted and followed while banners, armored horsemen, brocade-clad attendants, and others flanked the procession, with the incense carriage, fans, and the like going ahead.

sentences.zh: 至都門郊外，俟禦容車少駐，導從官下馬，車前立班，再拜。

translations.literal: At the suburban gate of the capital, they waited until the portrait carriage halted briefly; the guiding and attendant officials dismounted, formed ranks before the carriage, and bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: At the capital's suburban gate they waited until the portrait carriage paused; escorting officials dismounted, formed ranks before the carriage, and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 奉送使副側侍不拜。

translations.literal: The chief and deputy envoys of the escort stood at the side in attendance and did not bow.
translations.idiomatic: The chief and deputy escort envoys stood at the side in attendance and did not bow.

sentences.zh: 班首詣香輿，跪上香，俯伏，興，還班，再拜辭訖，退。

translations.literal: The lead of the rank went to the incense carriage, knelt to offer incense, prostrated himself, rose, returned to his rank, bowed twice in farewell, and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The rank lead went to the incense carriage, knelt to offer incense, prostrated himself, rose, returned to his station, bowed twice in farewell, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 使副遂行。

translations.literal: The chief and deputy envoys then set out.
translations.idiomatic: The chief and deputy envoys then departed.

sentences.zh: 每程到館或廨舍內安駐。

translations.literal: At each stage they lodged the portrait within a relay station or official quarters.
translations.idiomatic: At each stage of the journey the portrait was lodged inside a relay station or official quarters.

sentences.zh: 其道路儀衛，紅羅傘一，龍車一，其制以青布為亭子狀，安車上，駕以牛。

translations.literal: The roadside ceremonial guard comprised one red-silk umbrella, one dragon carriage—its frame a pavilion of blue cloth set on the carriage, drawn by oxen.
translations.idiomatic: The roadside escort comprised one red-silk umbrella and one dragon carriage—a blue-cloth pavilion mounted on the carriage and drawn by oxen.

sentences.zh: 又用駝五，旗鼓共五十，舁香輿一十人，導從六十人，執扇八人，兵士百人，護衛二十人以宗室猛安謀克子孫充。

translations.literal: There were also five camels, fifty banners and drums, ten bearers of the incense carriage, sixty guides and attendants, eight fan-bearers, one hundred soldiers, and twenty guards drawn from descendants of the imperial clan, meng'an, and mouke.
translations.idiomatic: There were also five camels, fifty banners and drums, ten bearers for the incense carriage, sixty guides and attendants, eight fan-bearers, one hundred soldiers, and twenty guards drawn from descendants of the imperial clan, meng'an, and mouke.

sentences.zh: 所過州縣，官屬公服出郭香果奉迎，再拜，班首上香奠酒，又再拜。

translations.literal: At each prefecture and county passed through, officials in formal dress went beyond the city wall with incense and fruit to welcome them, bowed twice, the lead offered incense and wine, and bowed twice again.
translations.idiomatic: At each prefecture and county along the route, officials in court dress went beyond the walls with incense and fruit to welcome the procession, bowed twice, the rank lead offered incense and wine, and all bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 送至郊外，再拜乃退。

translations.literal: They escorted them to the suburbs, bowed twice, and then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: They escorted the procession to the suburbs, bowed twice, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 至會寧府，官屬備香輿奉迎如上儀，乘馬從至廟門外下馬，分左右導引。

translations.literal: Upon reaching Huining Prefecture, officials prepared the incense carriage and welcomed them with the same rites; they rode on horseback in attendance, dismounted outside the temple gate, and guided left and right.
translations.idiomatic: At Huining Prefecture, officials prepared the incense carriage and welcomed them with the same rites; they rode in attendance, dismounted outside the temple gate, and guided on either side.

sentences.zh: 使副率太祝四員，捧禦容入廟，於中門外東壁幄次內奉置定，再拜，訖，退，擇日奉安。

translations.literal: The chief and deputy envoys led four chief invokers in bearing the imperial portrait into the temple; within the curtained enclosure on the east wall outside the middle gate they reverently set it in place, bowed twice, withdrew, and chose a day for the installation rite.
translations.idiomatic: The chief and deputy envoys led four chief invokers bearing the portrait into the temple; within the curtained enclosure on the east wall outside the middle gate they set it reverently in place, bowed twice, withdrew, and chose a day for the formal installation.

sentences.zh: 至日質明，差去官與本府官及建廟官等並公服，詣幄次前排立，先再拜，跪上香，樂作，奠酒，訖，又再拜。

translations.literal: At dawn on the appointed day, the dispatched officials, prefectural officials, temple-building officials, and others, all in formal dress, formed ranks before the enclosure, first bowed twice, knelt to offer incense while music played, presented wine, and bowed twice again.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn on the appointed day, the dispatched officials, prefectural officials, temple-building officials, and others—all in court dress—formed ranks before the enclosure, bowed twice, knelt to offer incense while music played, presented wine, and bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 太祝捧禦容，眾官前導引，至殿下排立。

translations.literal: The chief invoker bore the imperial portrait; the officials guided ahead to the forecourt, where they formed ranks.
translations.idiomatic: The chief invoker bore the portrait while the officials guided ahead to the forecourt and formed ranks.

sentences.zh: 禦容升殿奉安，訖，再拜，班首升殿，跪上香，讀祝，奠酒，樂作，少退再拜，訖，班首降階復位，同執事官再拜，訖，退。

translations.literal: The portrait was borne up to the hall and reverently installed; when finished, all bowed twice; the lead ascended, knelt to offer incense, read the prayer, presented wine while music played, withdrew slightly and bowed twice again; the lead descended and returned to his place; the officiating officials bowed twice together; when finished, they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The portrait was carried up to the hall and installed; all bowed twice. The rank lead ascended, knelt to offer incense, read the prayer, and presented wine while music played, then withdrew slightly and bowed twice again. The lead descended and returned to his station; the officiating officials bowed twice together and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 十五年二月，有司言東京開覺寺藏睿宗皇帝皁衣展裹真容，敕遷本京祖廟奉祀，仍易袍色。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fifteenth year, the relevant offices stated that Kaijue Temple in the Eastern Capital held the true portrait of Emperor Ruizong in black robes with outspread wrapping; an edict ordered it transferred to the ancestral temple of the capital for worship, and the robe color changed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fifteenth year, the responsible offices reported that Kaijue Temple in the Eastern Capital held the true portrait of Emperor Ruizong in black robes with outspread wrapping. An edict ordered it moved to the capital's ancestral temple for worship and the robe color changed.

sentences.zh: 明年四月，詔依奉安睿宗禮，奉安世祖禦容于衍慶宮。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the following year, an edict ordered that the imperial portrait of Emperor Shizu be reverently installed in Yansqing Palace according to the rites used for Emperor Ruizong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the following year, an edict directed that the imperial portrait of Emperor Shizu be installed in Yansqing Palace following the rites used for Emperor Ruizong.

sentences.zh: 前期，有司備香案、酒果、教坊樂。

translations.literal: Beforehand, the relevant offices prepared incense tables, wine and fruit, and Court Music Office performers.
translations.idiomatic: Beforehand, the responsible offices prepared incense tables, wine and fruit, and musicians from the Court Music Office.

sentences.zh: 至日質明，親王宰執率百官公服迎引至衍慶宮，凡用甲騎百人，傘二人，扇十二人、香輿八人、彩輿十六人、從者二十四人、執事官二人，弩手控鶴各五十人、贊者二人、禮直官二人，六品以下官三十員公服乘馬前導。

translations.literal: At dawn on the day, princes and chief councillors led all officials in formal dress to welcome and escort the portrait to Yansqing Palace—employing in all one hundred armored horsemen, two umbrellas, twelve fan-bearers, eight incense-carriage bearers, sixteen colored-carriage bearers, twenty-four attendants, two officiating officials, fifty crossbowmen and fifty crane handlers each, two announcers, two ritual protocol officers, and thirty officials of the sixth rank and below in formal dress riding ahead as guides.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn that day, princes and chief councillors led all officials in court dress to welcome and escort the portrait to Yansqing Palace: one hundred armored horsemen, two umbrellas, twelve fan-bearers, eight incense-carriage bearers, sixteen colored-carriage bearers, twenty-four attendants, two officiating officials, fifty crossbowmen and fifty crane handlers, two announcers, two ritual protocol officers, and thirty officials of the sixth rank and below in court dress riding ahead as guides.

sentences.zh: 奉安訖，百官再拜，禮畢，退立宮門之外，迎駕朝謁。

translations.literal: When the installation was complete, all officials bowed twice; the rite concluded; they withdrew and stood outside the palace gate to welcome the emperor for the pilgrimage audience.
translations.idiomatic: Once installation was complete, all officials bowed twice. The rite concluded; they withdrew to stand outside the palace gate to welcome the emperor for the pilgrimage audience.

sentences.zh: 十六年正月，有司奏：「奉敕議世祖皇帝禦容當於何處安置。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixteenth year, the relevant offices memorialized: "By imperial command we deliberated where the imperial portrait of Emperor Shizu should be installed."
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixteenth year, the responsible offices memorialized: "By imperial command we have deliberated where the imperial portrait of Emperor Shizu should be installed."

sentences.zh: 臣等參詳衍慶宮即漢之原廟，每遇太祖皇帝忌辰，百官朝拜。

translations.literal: We have examined that Yansqing Palace is the Han-style original temple; on each anniversary of Emperor Taizu's death all officials perform the court audience.
translations.idiomatic: We find that Yansqing Palace is the Han-style original shrine; on each anniversary of Emperor Taizu's death all officials perform the court audience.

sentences.zh: 今世祖皇帝擇地修建殿位，庶可副嚴奉之意。

translations.literal: For Emperor Shizu, selecting a site and building a hall would fulfill the intent of reverent veneration.
translations.idiomatic: For Emperor Shizu, selecting a site and building a hall would fulfill the intent of reverent veneration.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 乃敕于聖武殿東西興建世祖、太宗、睿宗殿位。

translations.literal: An edict then ordered halls for Emperors Shizu, Taizong, and Ruizong built to the east and west of Shengwu Hall.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then ordered halls for Emperors Shizu, Taizong, and Ruizong built to the east and west of Shengwu Hall.

sentences.zh: 既而複欲擇地建太宗殿於歸仁館，有司言：「山陵太祖、太宗、睿宗共一兆域，太廟世祖、太祖、太宗、睿宗亦同堂異室。

translations.literal: Later they again wished to choose a site and build a hall for Emperor Taizong at Guiren Lodge; the relevant offices stated: "At the mountain tombs, Emperors Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong share one burial precinct; in the Grand Ancestral Temple, Emperors Shizu, Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong also share one hall with separate chambers."
translations.idiomatic: Later they again wished to build a hall for Emperor Taizong at Guiren Lodge. The responsible offices reported: "At the mountain tombs, Emperors Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong share one burial precinct; in the Grand Ancestral Temple, Emperors Shizu, Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong share one hall with separate chambers."

sentences.zh: 今于歸仁館興建太宗殿位，似與山陵、太廟之制不同。

translations.literal: To build a hall for Emperor Taizong at Guiren Lodge now seems inconsistent with the systems of the mountain tombs and Grand Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Building a separate hall for Emperor Taizong at Guiren Lodge now would seem inconsistent with the systems of the mountain tombs and Grand Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 」詔從前議，止于衍慶宮各建殿七間、閣五間、三門五間。

translations.literal: An edict followed the earlier proposal: only at Yansqing Palace were halls of seven bays, pavilions of five bays, and triple gates of five bays built for each.
translations.idiomatic: An edict followed the earlier proposal: at Yansqing Palace alone, each emperor received a hall of seven bays, a pavilion of five bays, and triple gates of five bays.

sentences.zh: 乃定世祖殿曰廣德、閣曰燕昌，太宗殿曰丕承、閣曰光昭，睿宗殿曰天興、閣曰景福。

translations.literal: Thereupon Shizu's hall was named Guangde and his pavilion Yanchang; Taizong's hall Pichang and pavilion Guangzhao; Ruizong's hall Tianxing and pavilion Jingfu.
translations.idiomatic: Shizu's hall was named Guangde and his pavilion Yanchang; Taizong's hall Pichang and pavilion Guangzhao; Ruizong's hall Tianxing and pavilion Jingfu.

sentences.zh: 十九年五月六日，奏告。

translations.literal: On the sixth day of the fifth month of the nineteenth year, a report was made to the temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixth day of the fifth month of the nineteenth year, a report was made to the temple.

sentences.zh: 七日，奉安。

translations.literal: On the seventh day, the reverent installation was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On the seventh day, the installation rite was performed.

sentences.zh: 執事禮官二人，每位香案一、祭器席一、拜褥二、盥洗一、大勺篚巾全。

translations.literal: Two ritual officiants were assigned; for each seat, one incense table, one mat of sacrificial vessels, two kneeling mats, one hand-washing station, and a complete set of ladles, baskets, and towels.
translations.idiomatic: Two ritual officiants were assigned; for each seat there was one incense table, one mat of sacrificial vessels, two kneeling mats, one hand-washing station, and a complete set of ladles, baskets, and towels.

sentences.zh: 前一日，太廟令率其屬掃除宮內外，又各設神座於殿上，又設親王宰執以下百官拜位於殿庭。

translations.literal: On the previous day, the director of the Grand Ancestral Temple led his subordinates in sweeping inside and outside the palace, set out spirit seats on the hall for each, and set the bowing places in the forecourt for princes, chief councillors, and all officials below them.
translations.idiomatic: On the previous day, the director of the Grand Ancestral Temple led his staff in sweeping the palace inside and out, set spirit seats on the hall for each emperor, and arranged bowing stations in the forecourt for princes, chief councillors, and all officials below them.

sentences.zh: 又設盥洗位於東階下，執罍篚者位於其後。

translations.literal: A hand-washing station was also set below the east steps, with the bearers of ewers and baskets behind it.
translations.idiomatic: A hand-washing station was also set below the east steps, with bearers of ewers and baskets stationed behind it.

sentences.zh: 又於神位前各設北向拜褥位，並各設香案香爐匙合香酒花果器皿物等，依前來例。

translations.literal: Before each spirit seat a north-facing kneeling mat was set, and for each an incense table, censer, spoons, boxes, incense, wine, fruit, flowers, vessels, and the like were set out according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Before each spirit seat a north-facing kneeling mat was set, with incense tables, censers, spoons, boxes, incense, wine, fruit, flowers, vessels, and the like arranged for each according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 又于聖武殿上設香案爐匙合香等，又于殿下各設腰輿一、舁士一十六人、傘子各二人、執扇各十二人、導從弩手各三十人。

translations.literal: On Shengwu Hall incense tables, censers, spoons, boxes, incense, and the like were also set out; below the hall for each was set one sedan chair, sixteen bearers, two umbrellas each, twelve fan-bearers each, and thirty crossbowmen as guides and attendants each.
translations.idiomatic: On Shengwu Hall incense tables, censers, spoons, boxes, and incense were also set out; below the hall each emperor had one sedan chair, sixteen bearers, two umbrellas, twelve fan-bearers, and thirty crossbowmen as guides and attendants.

sentences.zh: 前一日，清齋，親王于本府，百官於其第。

translations.literal: On the previous day they observed ritual purification: princes in their mansions, officials at their residences.
translations.idiomatic: On the previous day they observed ritual purification—princes in their mansions, officials at their residences.

sentences.zh: 行禮官執事人等習儀，就祠所清齋。

translations.literal: The officiating ritual officials and attendants rehearsed the rites and observed purification at the shrine.
translations.idiomatic: The officiating ritual officials and attendants rehearsed the rites and observed purification at the shrine.

sentences.zh: 其日質明，禮官率太廟署官等詣崇聖閣奉世祖禦容，每匣用內侍二人、太祝一員，禮官、署官前導，置於聖武殿神座。

translations.literal: At dawn that day, ritual officials led Grand Ancestral Temple staff to Chongsheng Pavilion to receive the imperial portrait of Emperor Shizu; for each casket two palace attendants and one chief invoker were used; ritual and temple officials guided ahead and placed it on the spirit seat in Shengwu Hall.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn that day, ritual officials led Grand Ancestral Temple staff to Chongsheng Pavilion to receive Emperor Shizu's portrait; each casket was borne by two palace attendants and one chief invoker, with ritual and temple officials guiding ahead to place it on the spirit seat in Shengwu Hall.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引親王宰執百官公服于殿庭班立，七品以下班於殿門之外，贊者曰：「拜。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol officer led princes, chief councillors, and all officials in formal dress to form ranks in the forecourt; those of the seventh rank and below formed ranks outside the hall gate; the announcer said: "Bow."
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol officer led princes, chief councillors, and all officials in court dress to form ranks in the forecourt; those of the seventh rank and below formed ranks outside the hall gate. The announcer called: "Bow."

sentences.zh: 」在位官皆再拜。

translations.literal: All officials in their places bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: All officials in their stations bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引班首詣罍洗，盥手訖，升殿，詣神座前跪上香，訖，少退，再拜。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol officer led the lead of the rank to the ewer-washing station; when hand-washing was finished, he ascended, went before the spirit seat, knelt to offer incense, withdrew slightly, and bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol officer led the rank lead to the ewer-washing station; after washing his hands he ascended, went before the spirit seat, knelt to offer incense, withdrew slightly, and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引班首降殿復位，贊者曰：「拜。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol officer led the lead down from the hall to his place; the announcer said: "Bow."
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol officer led the rank lead down from the hall to his station. The announcer called: "Bow."

sentences.zh: 」在位官皆再拜，訖，禮直官導世祖禦容升腰輿，儀衛依次序導從，至廣德殿，百官後從，至庭下班位立。

translations.literal: All officials in their places bowed twice; when finished, the ritual protocol officer guided the imperial portrait of Emperor Shizu onto the sedan chair; ceremonial guards followed in order to Guangde Hall; all officials followed behind; at the forecourt they formed ranks.
translations.idiomatic: All officials in their stations bowed twice. The ritual protocol officer then guided Emperor Shizu's portrait onto the sedan chair; ceremonial guards followed in order to Guangde Hall while all officials followed behind and formed ranks in the forecourt.

sentences.zh: 禮官率太廟署官就腰輿內捧禦容，於殿上正面奉安訖，百官於階下，六品已下官於殿門外，立班。

translations.literal: Ritual officials led Grand Ancestral Temple staff in bearing the portrait from within the sedan chair; on the hall they reverently installed it facing forward; officials stood below the steps, those of the sixth rank and below outside the hall gate, in ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officials led Grand Ancestral Temple staff in bearing the portrait from the sedan chair and installing it reverently on the hall facing forward. Officials stood below the steps, those of the sixth rank and below outside the hall gate, in ranks.

sentences.zh: 贊者曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: The announcer said: "Bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: The announcer called: "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 」在位官皆再拜。

translations.literal: All officials in their places bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: All officials in their stations bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引班首盥洗，盥手訖，升殿，執事官等從升，詣禦容前，跪上香，奠酒，教坊樂作，少退再拜，訖，樂止。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol officer led the lead to wash; when hand-washing was finished, he ascended, officiating officials ascending with him; before the portrait he knelt to offer incense and present wine; the Court Music Office performed; he withdrew slightly and bowed twice; when finished, the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol officer led the rank lead to wash his hands, then ascend with the officiating officials. Before the portrait he knelt to offer incense and wine while the Court Music Office played; he withdrew slightly and bowed twice, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引班首降殿復位，贊者曰：「拜。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol officer led the lead down from the hall to his place; the announcer said: "Bow."
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol officer led the rank lead down from the hall to his station. The announcer called: "Bow."

sentences.zh: 」在位官皆再拜。

translations.literal: All officials in their places bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: All officials in their stations bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 訖，禮官率太廟署官詣崇聖閣。

translations.literal: When finished, ritual officials led Grand Ancestral Temple staff to Chongsheng Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: When this was done, ritual officials led Grand Ancestral Temple staff to Chongsheng Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 太祝內侍捧太宗禦容，禮官導太宗禦容置於聖武殿，行禮畢，以次奉安於丕承殿，行禮並如上儀。

translations.literal: Chief invokers and palace attendants bore the imperial portrait of Emperor Taizong; ritual officials guided it to Shengwu Hall; when the rites were complete, it was reverently installed in turn at Pichang Hall, the rites all as above.
translations.idiomatic: Chief invokers and palace attendants bore Emperor Taizong's portrait; ritual officials guided it to Shengwu Hall. When the rites were complete, it was installed in turn at Pichang Hall with the same ceremonies as above.

sentences.zh: 次睿宗禦容奉安於天興殿，禮亦如之。

translations.literal: Next the imperial portrait of Emperor Ruizong was reverently installed at Tianxing Hall, the rites likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Next Emperor Ruizong's portrait was installed at Tianxing Hall with the same rites.

sentences.zh: 俟奉安禮畢，百官退。

translations.literal: When the installation rites were complete, all officials withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When the installation rites were complete, all officials withdrew.

sentences.zh: 二十一年閏三月，奉旨昭祖、景祖奉安燕昌閣上，肅宗、穆宗、康宗奉安閣下，明肅皇帝奉安崇聖閣下。

translations.literal: In the intercalary third month of the twenty-first year, by imperial command the portraits of Ancestor Zhao and Ancestor Jing were reverently installed in the upper story of Yanchang Pavilion, those of Emperor Suzong, Emperor Muzong, and Emperor Kangzong in the lower story, and Emperor Mingsu in the lower story of Chongsheng Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary third month of the twenty-first year, by imperial command the portraits of Ancestor Zhao and Ancestor Jing were installed in the upper story of Yanchang Pavilion, those of Emperor Suzong, Emperor Muzong, and Emperor Kangzong in the lower story, and Emperor Mingsu in the lower story of Chongsheng Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 每位設黃羅幕一、黃羅明金柱衣二、紫羅地褥一、龍床一、踏床二、衣全，前期奏告。

translations.literal: For each seat were set one yellow-silk curtain, two yellow-silk pillar garments with bright gold, one purple-silk ground mat, one dragon bed, two footstools, and a complete set of garments; a report was made to the temple beforehand.
translations.idiomatic: For each seat there was one yellow-silk curtain, two yellow-silk pillar garments with bright gold, one purple-silk ground mat, one dragon bed, two footstools, and a complete set of garments, with a report to the temple made beforehand.

sentences.zh: 四月一日奉安，五日親祀。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fourth month the reverent installation was performed; on the fifth day the emperor sacrificed in person.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fourth month the installation was performed; on the fifth day the emperor sacrificed in person.

sentences.zh: 是年五月，遷聖安寺睿宗皇帝禦容于衍慶宮，皇太子親王宰執奉迎安置。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of that year, the imperial portrait of Emperor Ruizong was transferred from Sheng'an Temple to Yansqing Palace; the crown prince, princes, and chief councillors welcomed and installed it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of that year, Emperor Ruizong's portrait was moved from Sheng'an Temple to Yansqing Palace; the crown prince, princes, and chief councillors welcomed and installed it.

sentences.zh: 朝謁儀

translations.literal: Rites of Pilgrimage Audience
translations.idiomatic: Rites of Pilgrimage Audience

sentences.zh: 大定十六年四月十九日，奉安世祖禦容，行朝謁之禮。

translations.literal: On the nineteenth day of the fourth month of the sixteenth year of Dading, the imperial portrait of Emperor Shizu was reverently installed and the rites of pilgrimage audience performed.
translations.idiomatic: On the nineteenth day of the fourth month of Dading 16, Emperor Shizu's portrait was installed and the pilgrimage audience rites were performed.

sentences.zh: 皇帝前一日齋於內殿，皇太子齋于本宮，親王齋于本府，百官齋於其第。

translations.literal: The emperor observed purification in the inner hall on the previous day; the crown prince in his palace; princes in their mansions; officials at their residences.
translations.idiomatic: On the previous day the emperor observed purification in the inner hall, the crown prince in his palace, princes in their mansions, and officials at their residences.

sentences.zh: 太廟令率其屬，于衍慶宮內外掃除，設親王百官拜位於殿庭，又設皇太子拜褥于親王百官位前。

translations.literal: The director of the Grand Ancestral Temple led his subordinates in sweeping inside and outside Yansqing Palace, set the bowing places of princes and all officials in the forecourt, and set the crown prince's kneeling mat before the places of princes and officials.
translations.idiomatic: The director of the Grand Ancestral Temple led his staff in sweeping Yansqing Palace inside and out, arranged bowing stations for princes and all officials in the forecourt, and set the crown prince's kneeling mat before their stations.

sentences.zh: 宣徽院率其屬，于聖武門外之東設西向禦幄，靈星門東設皇太子幄次。

translations.literal: The Palace Domestic Service led its subordinates in setting a west-facing imperial enclosure east of Shengwu Gate, and the crown prince's enclosure east of Lingxing Gate.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Domestic Service led its staff in setting a west-facing imperial enclosure east of Shengwu Gate and the crown prince's enclosure east of Lingxing Gate.

sentences.zh: 其日，有司列仗衛于應天門，俟奉安禦容訖，有司於殿上並神御前設北向拜褥位，安置香爐香案並香酒器物等。

translations.literal: That day the relevant offices arrayed guards at Yingtian Gate; when the installation of the portrait was complete, they set north-facing kneeling mats on the hall and before the spirit seat, and arranged censers, incense tables, incense, wine, vessels, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: That day the responsible offices arrayed guards at Yingtian Gate. When the portrait installation was complete, they set north-facing kneeling mats on the hall and before the spirit seat and arranged censers, incense tables, incense, wine, vessels, and the like.

sentences.zh: 皇太子比至車駕進發已前，公服乘馬，本宮官屬導從，至衍慶宮門西下馬，步入幄次。

translations.literal: The crown prince, arriving before the imperial procession set out, rode in formal dress with officials of his palace guiding and attending; west of Yansqing Palace gate he dismounted and entered his enclosure on foot.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince arrived before the imperial procession set out, riding in court dress with his palace officials guiding and attending. West of Yansqing Palace gate he dismounted and entered his enclosure on foot.

sentences.zh: 親王百官于衍慶宮門外西向立班。

translations.literal: Princes and all officials formed west-facing ranks outside the gate of Yansqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Princes and all officials formed west-facing ranks outside Yansqing Palace gate.

sentences.zh: 俟車駕將至，典贊儀引皇太子出幄次，于親王百官班前奉迎。

translations.literal: When the imperial procession was about to arrive, the master of ritual praise led the crown prince out of his enclosure to welcome it before the ranks of princes and officials.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial procession was about to arrive, the master of ritual praise led the crown prince out of his enclosure to welcome it before the ranks of princes and officials.

sentences.zh: 導駕官，五品六品七品職官內差四十員于應天門外道南立班以俟。

translations.literal: Forty officials of the fifth, sixth, and seventh ranks were selected from among those holding posts to serve as procession guides, forming ranks south of the road outside Yingtian Gate to await.
translations.idiomatic: Forty officials of the fifth, sixth, and seventh ranks were selected as procession guides and formed ranks south of the road outside Yingtian Gate to await the emperor.

sentences.zh: 皇帝服靴袍乘輦，從官傘扇侍衛如常儀。

translations.literal: The emperor wore boots and robe and rode in the palanquin; attendant officials with umbrellas, fans, and guards followed the usual rites.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wore boots and robe and rode in the palanquin; attendant officials with umbrellas, fans, and guards followed the usual protocol.

sentences.zh: 敕旨用大安輦、儀仗一千人。

translations.literal: By imperial command the Da'an palanquin was used and one thousand ceremonial guards.
translations.idiomatic: By imperial command the Da'an palanquin was used with a ceremonial guard of one thousand.

sentences.zh: 出應天門，閣門通喝：「導駕官再拜。

translations.literal: Exiting Yingtian Gate, the Gate Department called out: "Procession guides, bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: Exiting Yingtian Gate, the Gate Department called out: "Procession guides, bow twice."

sentences.zh: 」訖，閣門傳敕：「道駕官上馬。

translations.literal: When finished, the Gate Department transmitted the command: "Procession guides, mount."
translations.idiomatic: When this was done, the Gate Department transmitted the command: "Procession guides, mount."

sentences.zh: 」分左右前導，至廟門外西偏下馬。

translations.literal: They guided ahead left and right; west of the temple gate they dismounted.
translations.idiomatic: They guided ahead on either side and dismounted west of the temple gate.

sentences.zh: 車駕至衍慶宮門外稍西降輦。

translations.literal: The imperial procession reached slightly west of the outer gate of Yansqing Palace and the emperor descended from the palanquin.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial procession reached slightly west of Yansqing Palace's outer gate and the emperor descended from the palanquin.

sentences.zh: 左右宣徽使前導，皇帝步入禦幄，簾降。

translations.literal: The left and right commissioners of the Palace Domestic Service guided ahead; the emperor entered the imperial enclosure on foot and the curtain was lowered.
translations.idiomatic: The left and right commissioners of the Palace Domestic Service guided ahead; the emperor entered the imperial enclosure on foot and the curtain was lowered.

sentences.zh: 閣門先引親王、宰執、四品已上執事官，由東西偏門入，至殿庭分東西班相向立。

translations.literal: The Gate Department first led in princes, chief councillors, and officiating officials of the fourth rank and above through the east and west side gates; in the forecourt they divided into east and west ranks facing each other.
translations.idiomatic: The Gate Department first led in princes, chief councillors, and officiating officials of the fourth rank and above through the east and west side gates; in the forecourt they divided into east and west ranks facing each other.

sentences.zh: 典贊儀引皇太子入，立於褥位之西，東向。

translations.literal: The master of ritual praise led the crown prince in; he stood west of the kneeling mat, facing east.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ritual praise led the crown prince in to stand west of the kneeling mat, facing east.

sentences.zh: 進香進酒等執事官並升階，於殿上分東西向以次立。

translations.literal: The officiating officials for presenting incense and wine all ascended the steps and on the hall stood in east and west ranks in order.
translations.idiomatic: The officiating officials for presenting incense and wine all ascended the steps and stood in east and west ranks on the hall in order.

sentences.zh: 宣徽使跪奏：「請皇帝行朝謁之禮。

translations.literal: The commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service knelt and reported: "We request that the emperor perform the rites of pilgrimage audience."
translations.idiomatic: The commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service knelt and reported: "We request that Your Majesty perform the pilgrimage audience rites."

sentences.zh: 」簾卷，皇帝出幄。

translations.literal: The curtain was raised and the emperor emerged from the enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: The curtain was raised and the emperor emerged from the enclosure.

sentences.zh: 宣徽使前導，至殿上褥位，北向立。

translations.literal: The commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service guided ahead to the kneeling mat on the hall, where the emperor stood facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service guided him to the kneeling mat on the hall, where the emperor stood facing north.

sentences.zh: 典贊儀引皇太子就褥位，閣門引親王宰執四品已上職事官回班，並北向立。

translations.literal: The master of ritual praise led the crown prince to the kneeling mat; the Gate Department led princes, chief councillors, and duty officials of the fourth rank and above back to their ranks; all stood facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ritual praise led the crown prince to the kneeling mat; the Gate Department led princes, chief councillors, and duty officials of the fourth rank and above back to their ranks, all standing facing north.

sentences.zh: 令中間歇空，不礙奏樂。

translations.literal: They left an open space in the middle so as not to obstruct the music.
translations.idiomatic: They left an open space in the middle so the music would not be obstructed.

sentences.zh: 五品以下聖武門外、八品以下宮門外陪拜。

translations.literal: Those of the fifth rank and below accompanied the bows outside Shengwu Gate; those of the eighth rank and below outside the palace gate.
translations.idiomatic: Those of the fifth rank and below accompanied the bows outside Shengwu Gate; those of the eighth rank and below outside the palace gate.

sentences.zh: 二宣徽使奏請，皇帝再拜，教坊樂作。

translations.literal: The two commissioners of the Palace Domestic Service petitioned; the emperor bowed twice and the Court Music Office performed.
translations.idiomatic: The two commissioners of the Palace Domestic Service petitioned; the emperor bowed twice while the Court Music Office played.

sentences.zh: 皇太子已下群官皆再拜。

translations.literal: The crown prince and all officials below him bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince and all officials below him bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 請皇帝詣神御前褥位，北向立，又請皇帝再拜，皇太子已下群官皆再拜。

translations.literal: They requested that the emperor go to the kneeling mat before the spirit seat and stand facing north; again they requested that the emperor bow twice, and the crown prince and all officials below him bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: They requested that the emperor go to the kneeling mat before the spirit seat and stand facing north, then bow twice; the crown prince and all officials below him bowed twice as well.

sentences.zh: 請皇帝跪 ，三上香，三奠酒，俯伏，興。

translations.literal: They requested that the emperor kneel, offer incense three times, present wine three times, prostrate himself, and rise.
translations.idiomatic: They requested that the emperor kneel, offer incense three times, present wine three times, prostrate himself, and rise.

sentences.zh: 又請皇帝再拜，皇太子已下群官皆再拜，訖，皇帝復位。

translations.literal: Again they requested that the emperor bow twice; the crown prince and all officials below him bowed twice; when finished, the emperor returned to his place.
translations.idiomatic: Again they requested that the emperor bow twice; the crown prince and all officials below him bowed twice. When this was done, the emperor returned to his place.

sentences.zh: 又請皇帝再拜，皇太子已下群官皆再拜。

translations.literal: Again they requested that the emperor bow twice; the crown prince and all officials below him bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: Again they requested that the emperor bow twice; the crown prince and all officials below him bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 宣徽使奏：「禮畢。

translations.literal: The commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service reported: "The rites are complete."
translations.idiomatic: The commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service reported: "The rites are complete."

sentences.zh: 」已上擬八拜，宣徽院奏過，依舊例十二拜。

translations.literal: The above proposed eight bows; the Palace Domestic Service reported this and, following the old precedent, twelve bows were used.
translations.idiomatic: The above proposed eight bows; the Palace Domestic Service reported this, and following old precedent twelve bows were used.

sentences.zh: 典贊儀引皇太子複立于褥位之西，東向。

translations.literal: The master of ritual praise led the crown prince to stand again west of the kneeling mat, facing east.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ritual praise led the crown prince to stand again west of the kneeling mat, facing east.

sentences.zh: 閣門引親王宰執以下群官，東西相向立。

translations.literal: The Gate Department led princes, chief councillors, and all officials below them to stand facing each other east and west.
translations.idiomatic: The Gate Department led princes, chief councillors, and all officials below them to stand facing each other in east and west ranks.

sentences.zh: 先引五品已下官出。

translations.literal: They first led out officials of the fifth rank and below.
translations.idiomatic: They first led out officials of the fifth rank and below.

sentences.zh: 宣徽使前導，皇帝還禦幄，簾降。

translations.literal: The commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service guided ahead; the emperor returned to the imperial enclosure and the curtain was lowered.
translations.idiomatic: The commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service guided ahead; the emperor returned to the imperial enclosure and the curtain was lowered.

sentences.zh: 典贊儀引皇太子，閣門分引殿庭百官，以次出。

translations.literal: The master of ritual praise led the crown prince; the Gate Department led out the officials in the forecourt in separate groups, in order.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ritual praise led the crown prince; the Gate Department led the officials in the forecourt out in separate groups, in order.

sentences.zh: 宣徽使跪奏：「請皇帝還宮。

translations.literal: The commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service knelt and reported: "We request that the emperor return to the palace."
translations.idiomatic: The commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service knelt and reported: "We request that Your Majesty return to the palace."

sentences.zh: 」簾卷，步出廟門外，升輦還宮，如來儀。

translations.literal: The curtain was raised; he walked out beyond the temple gate, mounted the palanquin, and returned to the palace by the same rites as on arrival.
translations.idiomatic: The curtain was raised; he walked out beyond the temple gate, mounted the palanquin, and returned to the palace by the same protocol as on arrival.

sentences.zh: 十九年舉安禮同。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year the installation rite was the same.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year the installation rite was the same.

sentences.zh: 朝拜儀

translations.literal: Rites of Court Audience
translations.idiomatic: Rites of Court Audience

sentences.zh: 初，太祖忌辰，皇帝至褥位立，再拜。

translations.literal: Initially, on the anniversary of Emperor Taizu's death, the emperor came to the kneeling mat, stood, and bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, on the anniversary of Emperor Taizu's death, the emperor came to the kneeling mat, stood, and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 稍東，西向，詣香案前，又再拜。

translations.literal: Slightly to the east, facing west, he went before the incense table and bowed twice again.
translations.idiomatic: Slightly to the east, facing west, he went before the incense table and bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 上香訖，復位，又再拜。

translations.literal: When incense was offered, he returned to his place and bowed twice again.
translations.idiomatic: After offering incense he returned to his place and bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 進食、奠茶、辭神皆再拜而退。

translations.literal: Presenting food, offering tea, and taking leave of the spirit—all were performed with two bows and withdrawal.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting food, offering tea, and taking leave of the spirit were each performed with two bows before withdrawal.

sentences.zh: 大定二十一年五月十二日，睿宗忌辰，有司更定儀禮。

translations.literal: On the twelfth day of the fifth month of the twenty-first year of Dading, the anniversary of Emperor Ruizong's death, the relevant offices revised the ritual protocol.
translations.idiomatic: On the twelfth day of the fifth month of Dading 21, the anniversary of Emperor Ruizong's death, the responsible offices revised the ritual protocol.

sentences.zh: 前一日，宣徽院設禦幄於天興殿門外稍西。

translations.literal: On the previous day the Palace Domestic Service set the imperial enclosure slightly west of the outer gate of Tianxing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the previous day the Palace Domestic Service set the imperial enclosure slightly west of Tianxing Hall's outer gate.

sentences.zh: 至日質明，皇太子親王百官具公服于衍慶宮門外立班，奉迎。

translations.literal: At dawn on the day, the crown prince, princes, and all officials in formal dress formed ranks outside the gate of Yansqing Palace to welcome him.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn that day, the crown prince, princes, and all officials in court dress formed ranks outside Yansqing Palace gate to welcome the emperor.

sentences.zh: 皇帝乘馬至衍慶宮門外下馬，二宣徽使前導，步入宮門稍東。

translations.literal: The emperor rode to outside the gate of Yansqing Palace and dismounted; the two commissioners of the Palace Domestic Service guided ahead; he entered the palace gate on foot slightly to the east.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rode to Yansqing Palace gate and dismounted; the two commissioners of the Palace Domestic Service guided ahead as he entered the palace gate on foot, slightly to the east.

sentences.zh: 皇帝乘輦，傘扇侍衛如常儀，至天興殿門外稍西。

translations.literal: The emperor rode in the palanquin with umbrellas, fans, and guards as in the usual rites to slightly west of the outer gate of Tianxing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rode in the palanquin with umbrellas, fans, and guards as usual to slightly west of Tianxing Hall's outer gate.

sentences.zh: 皇帝降輦，入幄次，簾降，典贊儀引皇太子、閣門引親王宰執四品已上官由偏門入，至於殿庭，左右分班立定，二宣徽使導皇帝由天興門正門入，自東階升殿，詣褥位立定。

translations.literal: The emperor descended from the palanquin, entered the enclosure, and the curtain was lowered; the master of ritual praise led the crown prince; the Gate Department led princes, chief councillors, and officials of the fourth rank and above through the side gates to the forecourt, where they formed left and right ranks; the two commissioners guided the emperor through the main gate of Tianxing Hall, ascended the east steps, and took his place at the kneeling mat.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor descended from the palanquin and entered the enclosure; the curtain was lowered. The master of ritual praise led the crown prince; the Gate Department led princes, chief councillors, and officials of the fourth rank and above through the side gates to the forecourt, where they formed left and right ranks. The two commissioners guided the emperor through Tianxing Hall's main gate, up the east steps, to the kneeling mat.

sentences.zh: 皇太子已下官合班，五品以下班於殿門外。

translations.literal: Officials from the crown prince downward formed a combined rank; those of the fifth rank and below formed ranks outside the hall gate.
translations.idiomatic: Officials from the crown prince downward formed a combined rank; those of the fifth rank and below formed ranks outside the hall gate.

sentences.zh: 宣徽使奏：「請皇帝先再拜。

translations.literal: The commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service reported: "We request that the emperor first bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: The commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service reported: "We request that Your Majesty first bow twice."

sentences.zh: 請詣侍神位立。

translations.literal: We request that you go to stand at the attendant spirit seat.
translations.idiomatic: We request that you go to stand at the attendant spirit seat.

sentences.zh: 」俟有司置香案酒卓訖，請詣褥位，又再拜，三上香、奠酒，復位，再拜。

translations.literal: When the relevant offices had set out the incense table and wine tables, they requested that he go to the kneeling mat, bow twice again, offer incense three times and present wine, return to his place, and bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: When the responsible offices had set out the incense table and wine tables, they requested that he go to the kneeling mat, bow twice again, offer incense three times and present wine, return to his place, and bow twice.

sentences.zh: 已上，皇太子以下皆陪拜。

translations.literal: In all the above, from the crown prince downward all accompanied the bows.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the above, from the crown prince downward all accompanied the bows.

sentences.zh: 再奏：「請詣稍東侍神位立。

translations.literal: They reported again: "We request that you go to stand at the attendant spirit seat slightly to the east."
translations.idiomatic: They reported again: "We request that you go to stand at the attendant spirit seat slightly to the east."

sentences.zh: 」典贊儀引皇太子升殿赴褥位，先兩拜，奠酒再兩拜，降複褥位。

translations.literal: The master of ritual praise led the crown prince up the hall to the kneeling mat; he first bowed twice, presented wine and bowed twice again, descended and returned to the kneeling mat.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ritual praise led the crown prince up the hall to the kneeling mat; he bowed twice, presented wine and bowed twice again, then descended and returned to the kneeling mat.

sentences.zh: 次閣門引終獻官趙王上殿行禮。

translations.literal: Next the Gate Department led the Prince of Zhao, the final presenter, up the hall to perform the rites.
translations.idiomatic: Next the Gate Department led the Prince of Zhao, the final presenter, up the hall to perform the rites.

sentences.zh: 宣徽使奏：「請皇帝詣褥位。

translations.literal: The commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service reported: "We request that the emperor go to the kneeling mat."
translations.idiomatic: The commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service reported: "We request that Your Majesty go to the kneeling mat."

sentences.zh: 」再兩拜。

translations.literal: He bowed twice again.
translations.idiomatic: He bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 皇太子以下官皆再拜。

translations.literal: Officials from the crown prince downward all bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: Officials from the crown prince downward all bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，百官依前分班立。

translations.literal: When the rites were complete, all officials stood in their former left and right ranks.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites were complete, all officials stood in their former left and right ranks.

sentences.zh: 皇帝出殿門外，入幄次，簾降，更衣。

translations.literal: The emperor went outside the hall gate, entered the enclosure, the curtain was lowered, and he changed garments.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor went outside the hall gate, entered the enclosure, the curtain was lowered, and he changed garments.

sentences.zh: 次引皇太子以下官出宮門外立班。

translations.literal: Next they led officials from the crown prince downward out beyond the palace gate to form ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Next they led officials from the crown prince downward out beyond the palace gate to form ranks.

sentences.zh: 皇帝乘輦，至宮門稍東降輦，步出宮門外，上馬還宮，導從侍衛如來儀。

translations.literal: The emperor rode in the palanquin to slightly east of the palace gate and descended; he walked out beyond the palace gate, mounted, and returned to the palace; guides, attendants, and guards followed the rites of arrival.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rode in the palanquin to slightly east of the palace gate and descended; he walked out beyond the palace gate, mounted, and returned to the palace with guides, attendants, and guards following the same protocol as on arrival.

sentences.zh: 皇太子以下官，俟車駕行然後退。

translations.literal: Officials from the crown prince downward waited until the imperial procession had set out before withdrawing.
translations.idiomatic: Officials from the crown prince downward waited until the imperial procession had departed before withdrawing.

sentences.zh: 大定五年，奏旨：「太祖忌辰，衍慶宮薦享止用素食，諸京凡禦容所在皆同。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Dading, a memorial to the throne stated: "On the anniversary of Emperor Taizu's death, offerings at Yansqing Palace should use only vegetarian food; all capitals where imperial portraits are kept should follow the same rule."
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 5, a memorial to the throne stated: "On the anniversary of Emperor Taizu's death, offerings at Yansqing Palace should use only vegetarian food; all capitals where imperial portraits are kept should follow the same rule."

sentences.zh: 又朔望皆行朝拜禮。

translations.literal: On the first and fifteenth of each month the court audience rites should also be performed.
translations.idiomatic: On the first and fifteenth of each month the court audience rites should also be performed.

sentences.zh: 」六年，有司奏：「太祖皇帝忌辰，車駕親奠，百官陪拜。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, the relevant offices memorialized: "On the anniversary of Emperor Taizu's death, the imperial procession presents offerings in person and all officials accompany the bows."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, the responsible offices memorialized: "On the anniversary of Emperor Taizu's death, the emperor presents offerings in person and all officials accompany the bows."

sentences.zh: 今車駕巡幸，合以宰臣為班首，率百官詣衍慶宮行禮。

translations.literal: Now that the imperial procession is on tour, the chief minister should serve as lead of the rank and lead all officials to Yansqing Palace to perform the rites.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the emperor is on tour, the chief minister should lead the rank and take all officials to Yansqing Palace to perform the rites.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 十六年，奉旨：「世祖、太宗忌辰，一體奉奠。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, by imperial command: "On the anniversaries of Emperors Shizu and Taizong, offerings should be presented together."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, by imperial command: "On the anniversaries of Emperors Shizu and Taizong, offerings should be presented together."

sentences.zh: 」十八年八月，太祖忌辰 ，世祖、太宗同在一處致祭，有司言「歷代無一聖忌辰列聖預祭之典。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the eighteenth year, on the anniversary of Emperor Taizu's death, Emperors Shizu and Taizong were sacrificed to at the same place; the relevant offices stated: "Through the ages there is no precedent for other sage-emperors to receive preliminary sacrifice on one sage-emperor's anniversary."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the eighteenth year, on the anniversary of Emperor Taizu's death, Emperors Shizu and Taizong were sacrificed to at the same site. The responsible offices stated: "Through the ages there is no precedent for other sage-emperors to receive preliminary sacrifice on one sage-emperor's anniversary."

sentences.zh: 」擬議間，敕遣太子，一位行禮，並諸祭功臣。

translations.literal: While deliberation was underway, an edict dispatched the crown prince to perform the rites for one seat, and sacrifices to meritorious ministers as well.
translations.idiomatic: While deliberation was underway, an edict dispatched the crown prince to perform the rites for one seat and sacrifices to meritorious ministers as well.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，以內外祖廟不同，定擬：「太廟每歲五享，山陵朔、望、忌辰及節辰祭奠並依前代典故外，衍慶宮自來車駕行幸，遇祖宗忌辰百官行禮，並詣京祖廟節辰、忌辰、朔、望拜奠，雖無典故參酌，恐合依舊，以盡崇奉之意。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, because the inner and outer ancestral temples differed, it was decided: "The Grand Ancestral Temple holds five offerings each year; at the mountain tombs, sacrifices on the first and fifteenth, anniversaries, and festival days follow precedents of former ages. Apart from these, at Yansqing Palace the imperial procession has always paid visits; on ancestral anniversaries all officials perform the rites, and at the capital ancestral temples they bow and present offerings on festival days, anniversaries, and the first and fifteenth—though there is no precedent to consult, it is feared they should follow the old practice to fulfill the intent of reverent veneration."
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, because the inner and outer ancestral temples differed, it was decided: "The Grand Ancestral Temple holds five offerings each year; at the mountain tombs, sacrifices on the first and fifteenth, anniversaries, and festival days follow precedents of former ages. Apart from these, at Yansqing Palace the emperor has always paid visits; on ancestral anniversaries all officials perform the rites, and at the capital ancestral temples they bow and present offerings on festival days, anniversaries, and the first and fifteenth—though there is no clear precedent, they should follow established practice to fulfill the intent of reverent veneration."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 大定二年，有司擬奏閔宗無嗣，合別立廟，有司以時祭享，不稱宗，以武靈為廟號。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dading, the relevant offices proposed memorializing that Emperor Minzong had no heir and a separate temple should be established; the offices would perform seasonal sacrifices; he would not be called "Ancestor"; the temple name would be Wuling.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 2, the responsible offices proposed that because Emperor Minzong had no heir a separate temple should be established, with seasonal sacrifices performed by the offices; he would not be styled "Ancestor," and the temple name would be Wuling.

sentences.zh: 又奏：「唐立別廟，不必專在太廟垣內。

translations.literal: They also memorialized: "When the Tang established separate temples, they need not be confined within the walls of the Grand Ancestral Temple."
translations.idiomatic: They also memorialized: "When the Tang established separate temples, they need not be confined within the walls of the Grand Ancestral Temple."

sentences.zh: 今武靈皇帝既不稱宗，又不與祫享，其廟擬於太廟東墉外隙地建立。

translations.literal: Now Emperor Wuling is neither styled Ancestor nor included in the di and xia sacrifices; his temple is proposed to be built on vacant ground outside the east wall of the Grand Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Now Emperor Wuling is neither styled Ancestor nor included in the di and xia sacrifices; his temple is proposed for vacant ground outside the east wall of the Grand Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 十四年，廟成，以武靈後諡孝成，又謂之孝成廟。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year the temple was completed; posthumously Emperor Wuling was given the title Xiaocheng, and the temple was also called the Temple of Xiaocheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year the temple was completed; posthumously Emperor Wuling was given the title Xiaocheng, and the temple was also called the Temple of Xiaocheng.

sentences.zh: 十五年三月戊申，奉安武靈皇帝及悼皇后。

translations.literal: On the day wushen of the third month of the fifteenth year, Emperor Wuling and Empress Dao were reverently installed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen of the third month of the fifteenth year, Emperor Wuling and Empress Dao were ceremonially installed.

sentences.zh: 前期一日，奏告太廟十一室及昭德皇后廟，余如昭德過廟之儀。

translations.literal: One day beforehand, reports were made to the eleven chambers of the Grand Ancestral Temple and the temple of Empress Zhaode; the remainder followed the rites for passing through Zhaode's temple.
translations.idiomatic: One day beforehand, reports were made to the eleven chambers of the Grand Ancestral Temple and the temple of Empress Zhaode; the remainder followed the rites for passing through Zhaode's temple.

sentences.zh: 四月十七日，夏享太廟，同時行禮，命判宗正英王爽攝太尉，充初獻官。

translations.literal: On the seventeenth day of the fourth month, the summer offering at the Grand Ancestral Temple was performed at the same time; the Prince of Ying, Shuang, acting president of the Imperial Clan Court, was ordered to serve as Grand Commandant and act as the initial presenter.
translations.idiomatic: On the seventeenth day of the fourth month, the summer offering at the Grand Ancestral Temple was performed at the same time; the Prince of Ying, Shuang, acting president of the Imperial Clan Court, was ordered to serve as Grand Commandant and act as the initial presenter.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書讓攝司徒，差大理卿天錫攝太常卿，充亞獻。

translations.literal: Minister of War Rang served as Minister of Education; the chief judge of the Court of Judicial Review, Tiansi, was dispatched to serve as Minister of Rites and act as the secondary presenter.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Rang served as Minister of Education; Chief Judge Tiansi of the Court of Judicial Review was dispatched to serve as Minister of Rites and act as the secondary presenter.

sentences.zh: 大興少尹高居中攝光祿卿，充終獻。

translations.literal: Junior Administrator Gao Juzhong of Daxing served as Minister of Imperial Entertainments and acted as the final presenter.
translations.idiomatic: Junior Administrator Gao Juzhong of Daxing served as Minister of Imperial Entertainments and acted as the final presenter.

sentences.zh: 自是，歲常五享。

translations.literal: From this time, five offerings were held each year as a rule.
translations.idiomatic: From this time, five offerings were held each year as a rule.

sentences.zh: 十七年十月，祫享太廟，「檢討唐禮，孝敬皇帝廟時享用廟舞、宮縣、登歌，讓皇帝廟至禘祫月一祭，只用登歌，其禮制損益不同。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the seventeenth year, at the di and xia offering at the Grand Ancestral Temple: "Reviewing Tang ritual, the temple of Emperor Xiaojing used temple dance, palace music, and elevated song at seasonal offerings; the temple of Emperor Rang, down to the di and xia months with one sacrifice, used only elevated song—their ritual systems differed in what was added or reduced."
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the seventeenth year, at the di and xia offering at the Grand Ancestral Temple: "Reviewing Tang ritual, the temple of Emperor Xiaojing used temple dance, palace music, and elevated song at seasonal offerings; the temple of Emperor Rang, down to the di and xia months with one sacrifice, used only elevated song—their ritual systems differed in what was added or reduced."

sentences.zh: 今武靈皇帝廟庭與太廟地步不同，難以容設宮縣樂舞，並樂器亦是闕少，看詳恐合依唐讓皇帝祫享典故，樂用登歌，所有牲牢樽俎同太廟一室行禮。

translations.literal: Now the forecourt of Emperor Wuling's temple differs in size from the Grand Ancestral Temple, making it difficult to accommodate palace music and dance, and musical instruments are also lacking; on examination it is feared they should follow the Tang precedent for Emperor Rang's di and xia offering, using elevated song; all victims, wine vessels, and stands should follow the rites of one chamber of the Grand Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Now the forecourt of Emperor Wuling's temple differs in size from the Grand Ancestral Temple, making it difficult to accommodate palace music and dance, and musical instruments are also lacking. On examination they should follow the Tang precedent for Emperor Rang's di and xia offering, using elevated song; all victims, wine vessels, and stands should follow the rites of one chamber of the Grand Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 及契勘得自來祫享，遇親祠每室一犢，攝官行禮共用三犢。

translations.literal: On cross-checking, it was found that in di and xia offerings heretofore, when the emperor sacrificed in person there was one calf per chamber, and when acting officials performed the rites three calves were used in all.
translations.idiomatic: On cross-checking, it was found that in di and xia offerings heretofore, when the emperor sacrificed in person there was one calf per chamber, and when acting officials performed the rites three calves were used in all.

sentences.zh: 今添武靈皇帝別廟行禮，合無依已奏定共用三犢，或增添牛數。

translations.literal: Now that rites are added at the separate temple of Emperor Wuling, should they follow what was already memorialized and approved—three calves in all—or should the number of cattle be increased?
translations.idiomatic: Now that rites are added at the separate temple of Emperor Wuling, should they follow what was already memorialized and approved—three calves in all—or should the number of cattle be increased?

sentences.zh: 」奏奉敕旨：「太廟、別廟共用三犢，武靈皇帝廟樂用登歌，差官奏告，並准奏」。

translations.literal: A memorial received imperial command: "The Grand Ancestral Temple and separate temple shall share three calves; Emperor Wuling's temple shall use elevated song; officials shall be dispatched to report to the temple—all approved as memorialized."
translations.idiomatic: A memorial received imperial command: "The Grand Ancestral Temple and separate temple shall share three calves; Emperor Wuling's temple shall use elevated song; officials shall be dispatched to report to the temple—all approved as memorialized."

sentences.zh: 大定十九年四月，升祔太廟，其舊廟遂毀。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the nineteenth year of Dading, he was elevated to joint worship in the Grand Ancestral Temple and the old temple was then destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Dading 19, he was elevated to joint worship in the Grand Ancestral Temple and the old temple was then destroyed.

sentences.zh: 昭德皇后廟。

translations.literal: Temple of Empress Zhaode
translations.idiomatic: Temple of Empress Zhaode

sentences.zh: 大定二年，有司援唐典，昭德皇后合立別廟，擬於太廟內垣東北起建，從之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dading, the relevant offices cited Tang precedent: Empress Zhaode should have a separate temple established; it was proposed to build it in the northeast within the inner wall of the Grand Ancestral Temple; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 2, the responsible offices cited Tang precedent: Empress Zhaode should have a separate temple established in the northeast within the inner wall of the Grand Ancestral Temple; this was approved.

sentences.zh: 三年十月七日，太廟祫享，升祔睿宗皇帝並昭德皇后，神主同時製造題寫，奉詣殿庭，謁畢祔于祖姑欽仁皇后之左，享祀畢，奉主還本廟。

translations.literal: On the seventh day of the tenth month of the third year, at the di and xia offering of the Grand Ancestral Temple, Emperor Ruizong and Empress Zhaode were elevated to joint worship; spirit tablets were made and inscribed at the same time, borne to the forecourt, and after audience installed to the left of the ancestral aunt Empress Qinren; when the offering was complete, the tablets were borne back to their own temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the seventh day of the tenth month of the third year, at the Grand Ancestral Temple's di and xia offering, Emperor Ruizong and Empress Zhaode were elevated to joint worship. Spirit tablets were made and inscribed at the same time, borne to the forecourt, and after audience installed to the left of the ancestral aunt Empress Qinren. When the offering was complete, the tablets were returned to their own temple.

sentences.zh: 十二月二十一日，臘享，禮官言：「唐禮，別廟薦享皆准太廟一室之儀，伏恐今廟享畢已過質明，請別差官攝祭。

translations.literal: On the twenty-first day of the twelfth month, at the winter offering, ritual officials stated: "In Tang ritual, seasonal offerings at separate temples all follow the rites of one chamber of the Grand Ancestral Temple; we fear that when the main temple offering is complete it will already be past dawn—please separately assign officials to perform the sacrifice by proxy."
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-first day of the twelfth month, at the winter offering, ritual officials stated: "In Tang ritual, seasonal offerings at separate temples all follow the rites of one chamber of the Grand Ancestral Temple. We fear that when the main temple offering is complete it will already be past dawn—please separately assign officials to perform the sacrifice by proxy."

sentences.zh: 」制可。

translations.literal: The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 後以殿制小，又於太廟之東別建一位。

translations.literal: Later, because the hall was small, another site was built separately to the east of the Grand Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Later, because the hall was too small, another site was built separately to the east of the Grand Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 十二年八月，廟成，正殿三間，東西各空半間，以兩間為室，從西一間西壁上安置祏室。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twelfth year the temple was completed: a main hall of three bays, with half a bay vacant on east and west; two bays served as chambers, and the spirit niche was set in the west wall of the westernmost bay.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twelfth year the temple was completed: a main hall of three bays, with half a bay vacant on east and west; two bays served as chambers, and the spirit niche was set in the west wall of the westernmost bay.

sentences.zh: 廟置一便門，與太廟相通。

translations.literal: The temple was given one convenience gate connecting with the Grand Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: The temple was given one convenience gate connecting with the Grand Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 仍以舊殿為冊寶殿，祏室奏毀。

translations.literal: The old hall was retained as the Hall of Registers and Seals; the spirit niche was memorialized for demolition.
translations.idiomatic: The old hall was retained as the Hall of Registers and Seals; demolition of the spirit niche was memorialized.

sentences.zh: 十三年六月二十一日，奏告太廟，祭告別廟。

translations.literal: On the twenty-first day of the sixth month of the thirteenth year, reports were made to the Grand Ancestral Temple and announcement sacrifices to the separate temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-first day of the sixth month of the thirteenth year, reports were made to the Grand Ancestral Temple and announcement sacrifices to the separate temple.

sentences.zh: 二十三日，奉安，用前祫享過廟儀。

translations.literal: On the twenty-third day the reverent installation was performed, using the rites for passing through the temple at the previous di and xia offering.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-third day the installation was performed, using the rites for passing through the temple at the previous di and xia offering.

sentences.zh: 有司言當用鹵簿，以廟相去不遠，參酌擬用清道二人，次圍扇二人，次職掌八人，次衙官二十六人為十三重，供奉官充。

translations.literal: The relevant offices stated that the full guard of honor should be used; because the temples were not far apart, on deliberation they proposed two path-clearers, next two encircling fans, next eight ritual attendants, next twenty-six yamen officials in thirteen ranks, filled by palace service officials.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices stated that the full guard of honor should be used; because the temples were not far apart, on deliberation they proposed two path-clearers, then two encircling fans, then eight ritual attendants, then twenty-six yamen officials in thirteen ranks, filled by palace service officials.

sentences.zh: 次腰輿，輿士一十六人，傘子二人，次圍扇十四為七重，方扇四，次排列職掌六人，燭籠十對，輦官並錦襖盤裹。

translations.literal: Next a sedan chair with sixteen bearers, two umbrellas, next fourteen encircling fans in seven ranks, four square fans, next six ritual attendants in formation, ten pairs of candle lanterns, palanquin officials with brocade jackets and wrapped trays.
translations.idiomatic: Next a sedan chair with sixteen bearers and two umbrellas, then fourteen encircling fans in seven ranks and four square fans, then six ritual attendants in formation, ten pairs of candle lanterns, and palanquin officials with brocade jackets and wrapped trays.

sentences.zh: 仍令皇太子率百官行禮。

translations.literal: The crown prince was also ordered to lead all officials in performing the rites.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince was also ordered to lead all officials in performing the rites.

sentences.zh: 前一日，行事執事官就祠所清齋一宿，仍習儀。

translations.literal: On the previous day the officiating officials observed purification for one night at the shrine and rehearsed the rites.
translations.idiomatic: On the previous day the officiating officials observed purification for one night at the shrine and rehearsed the rites.

sentences.zh: 執事者視醴饌，太廟令帥其屬掃除廟之內外。

translations.literal: The attendants inspected the ritual food and drink; the director of the Grand Ancestral Temple led his subordinates in sweeping inside and outside the temple.
translations.idiomatic: The attendants inspected the ritual food and drink; the director of the Grand Ancestral Temple led his staff in sweeping the temple inside and out.

sentences.zh: 禮直官設皇太子西向位，執事官位皇太子後，近南，西向，各依品從立。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol officer set the crown prince's west-facing station; officiating officials stood behind the crown prince, near the south, facing west, each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol officer set the crown prince's west-facing station; officiating officials stood behind the crown prince near the south, facing west, each according to rank.

sentences.zh: 監祭，殿西階下東向立。

translations.literal: The supervisor of sacrifice stood below the west steps of the hall, facing east.
translations.idiomatic: The supervisor of sacrifice stood below the west steps of the hall, facing east.

sentences.zh: 及親王百官位於廟庭，北向，西上，又設祝案於神位之右，設尊彝之位於左，各加勺、冪、坫。

translations.literal: Princes and all officials took their places in the temple forecourt, facing north, seniority from the west; a prayer table was set to the right of the spirit seat and the positions of ritual vessels to the left, each with ladles, covers, and stands.
translations.idiomatic: Princes and all officials took their places in the temple forecourt, facing north, seniority from the west. A prayer table was set to the right of the spirit seat and ritual vessel positions to the left, each with ladles, covers, and stands.

sentences.zh: 又設祭器，皆籍以席，左一籩實以鹿脯，右一豆實以鹿臡。

translations.literal: Sacrificial vessels were also set out, all on mats: to the left one basket filled with dried venison, to the right one vessel filled with minced venison.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial vessels were also set out on mats: to the left one basket of dried venison, to the right one vessel of minced venison.

sentences.zh: 又設盥洗、爵洗位於橫街之南稍東。

translations.literal: Hand-washing and goblet-washing stations were also set slightly east of the south side of the cross street.
translations.idiomatic: Hand-washing and goblet-washing stations were also set slightly east of the south side of the cross street.

sentences.zh: 罍在洗東，加勺。

translations.literal: The ewer was east of the washing station, with a ladle added.
