translations.idiomatic: The ewer was east of the washing station, with a ladle added.

sentences.zh: 篚在洗西，南肆，實以巾。

translations.literal: The basket was west of the washing station, spread to the south, filled with towels.
translations.idiomatic: The basket was west of the washing station, spread to the south, filled with towels.

sentences.zh: 執罍篚者位於其後。

translations.literal: The bearers of ewers and baskets stood behind them.
translations.idiomatic: Bearers of ewers and baskets stood behind them.

sentences.zh: 太廟令又設神位於室內北墉下，當戶南向。

translations.literal: The director of the Grand Ancestral Temple also set the spirit seat below the north wall inside the chamber, facing south toward the door.
translations.idiomatic: The director of the Grand Ancestral Temple also set the spirit seat below the north wall inside the chamber, facing south toward the door.

sentences.zh: 設直幾一、黼扆一、莞席一、繅席一、次席二、紫綾厚褥一、紫綾蒙褥一併幄帳等，諸物並如舊廟之儀。

translations.literal: One straight table, one embroidered screen, one rush mat, one silk mat, two secondary mats, one thick purple-silk mattress, one purple-silk cover mattress, together with curtains and canopies and the like—all items as in the rites of the old temple.
translations.idiomatic: One straight table, one embroidered screen, one rush mat, one silk mat, two secondary mats, one thick purple-silk mattress, one purple-silk cover mattress, together with curtains and canopies—all as in the rites of the old temple.

sentences.zh: 又設望燎位於西神門外之北，設燎柴於位之北，預掘瘞坎於燎所，所司陳儀衛於舊廟門之外。

translations.literal: A station for viewing the burning offering was also set north of the west spirit gate outside; firewood for burning was set north of the station; a burial pit was dug in advance at the burning site; the relevant offices arrayed ceremonial guards outside the old temple gate.
translations.idiomatic: A station for viewing the burning offering was also set north of the west spirit gate outside; firewood was set north of the station; a burial pit was dug in advance at the burning site; the responsible offices arrayed ceremonial guards outside the old temple gate.

sentences.zh: 奉安日未明二刻，所司進方扇燭籠於舊廟殿門外，設腰輿一、傘一於殿階之下，南向。

translations.literal: On the day of reverent installation, two quarters before dawn, the relevant offices brought square fans and candle lanterns outside the gate of the old temple hall, and set one sedan chair and one umbrella below the hall steps, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: On installation day, two quarters before dawn, the responsible offices brought square fans and candle lanterns outside the old temple hall gate and set one sedan chair and one umbrella below the hall steps, facing south.

sentences.zh: 質明，皇太子公服乘馬，本宮官屬導從，至廟門外下馬，步入廟門，至幕。

translations.literal: At dawn the crown prince rode in formal dress with officials of his palace guiding and attending; outside the temple gate he dismounted, entered the temple gate on foot, and went to the curtain enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn the crown prince rode in court dress with his palace officials guiding and attending; outside the temple gate he dismounted, entered on foot, and went to the curtain enclosure.

sentences.zh: 次引親王百官常服由廟門入，於殿庭北向西上、重行立定。

translations.literal: Next princes and all officials in regular dress were led in through the temple gate; in the forecourt they formed north-facing ranks, seniority from the west, in double rows.
translations.idiomatic: Next princes and all officials in regular dress were led in through the temple gate and formed north-facing double ranks in the forecourt, seniority from the west.

sentences.zh: 次引皇太子于百官前絕席位立，贊者曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: Next the crown prince was led to stand before all officials at the separate station; the announcer said: "Bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: Next the crown prince was led to stand before all officials at the separate station. The announcer called: "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 」皆再拜。

translations.literal: All bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: All bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 宮闈令升殿，捧昭德皇后神主置於座，贊者曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: The director of palace gates ascended the hall, bore the spirit tablet of Empress Zhaode, and set it on the seat; the announcer said: "Bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: The director of palace gates ascended the hall, bore the spirit tablet of Empress Zhaode, and set it on the seat. The announcer called: "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 」皆再拜。

translations.literal: All bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: All bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 次引內常侍北向俯伏，跪奏：「請昭德皇后神主奉安於新廟，降殿升輿。

translations.literal: Next an inner palace attendant was led to prostrate himself facing north and kneel in report: "We request that the spirit tablet of Empress Zhaode be reverently installed at the new temple—descend from the hall and mount the sedan chair."
translations.idiomatic: Next an inner palace attendant was led to prostrate himself facing north and kneel in report: "We request that the spirit tablet of Empress Zhaode be installed at the new temple—descend from the hall and mount the sedan chair."

sentences.zh: 」奏訖，俯伏，興。

translations.literal: When the report was finished, he prostrated himself and rose.
translations.idiomatic: When the report was finished, he prostrated himself and rose.

sentences.zh: 捧幾內侍先捧幾匱跪置於輿，又宮闈令接神主，內侍前引，跪置於輿上幾後，覆以紅羅帕。

translations.literal: A palace attendant bearing the table-case first bore the table-case, knelt, and set it on the sedan chair; the director of palace gates then received the spirit tablet; an attendant guided ahead, knelt, and set it behind the table on the chair, covering it with a red-silk cloth.
translations.idiomatic: A palace attendant bearing the table-case first knelt and set it on the sedan chair; the director of palace gates then received the spirit tablet; an attendant guided ahead, knelt, and set it behind the table on the chair, covering it with a red-silk cloth.

sentences.zh: 內常侍以下分左右前引，皇太子步自舊廟先從行，親王次之，百官分左右後從，儀衛導從，至別廟殿下北向。

translations.literal: Inner palace attendants and those below guided ahead left and right; the crown prince walked on foot from the old temple, going first; princes followed; all officials followed behind left and right; ceremonial guards guided and attended; they reached below the separate temple hall, facing north.
translations.idiomatic: Inner palace attendants and those below guided ahead on either side; the crown prince walked on foot from the old temple, going first, princes next, and all officials following behind on either side with ceremonial guards. They reached below the separate temple hall, facing north.

sentences.zh: 內常侍於腰輿前俯伏，興，跪奏：「請降輿升殿。

translations.literal: An inner palace attendant prostrated himself before the sedan chair, rose, and knelt in report: "We request that you descend from the chair and ascend the hall."
translations.idiomatic: An inner palace attendant prostrated himself before the sedan chair, rose, and knelt in report: "We request that you descend from the chair and ascend the hall."

sentences.zh: 」內侍 捧幾匱前，宮闈令捧接神主升殿，置於座。

translations.literal: A palace attendant bore the table-case ahead; the director of palace gates bore and received the spirit tablet, ascended the hall, and set it on the seat.
translations.idiomatic: A palace attendant bore the table-case ahead; the director of palace gates bore the spirit tablet up the hall and set it on the seat.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引皇太子以下親王百官入殿庭，北向西上、重行立，皇太子在絕席立，禮直官贊曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol officer led the crown prince, princes, and all officials into the forecourt; they stood north-facing, seniority from the west, in double rows; the crown prince stood at the separate station; the ritual protocol officer intoned: "Bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol officer led the crown prince, princes, and all officials into the forecourt in north-facing double ranks, seniority from the west; the crown prince stood at the separate station. The ritual protocol officer called: "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 」皆再拜。

translations.literal: All bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: All bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 又贊曰：「行事官各就位。

translations.literal: He intoned again: "Officiating officials, each take your station."
translations.idiomatic: He called again: "Officiating officials, each take your station."

sentences.zh: 」禮直官引皇太子西向位立定。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol officer led the crown prince to his west-facing station and had him stand.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol officer led the crown prince to his west-facing station.

sentences.zh: 禮直官少前贊曰：「有司謹具，請行事。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol officer stepped slightly forward and intoned: "The relevant offices have duly prepared; we request that the rites be performed."
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol officer stepped slightly forward and called: "The responsible offices have duly prepared; we request that the rites be performed."

sentences.zh: 」即引皇太子就盥洗位，北向，搢笏，盥手，帨手，執笏。

translations.literal: He then led the crown prince to the hand-washing station, facing north; he inserted his tablet, washed his hands, dried them with a towel, and held his tablet.
translations.idiomatic: He then led the crown prince to the hand-washing station, facing north; he inserted his tablet, washed and dried his hands, and held his tablet.

sentences.zh: 詣爵洗位，北向立，搢笏，洗爵，拭爵以授執事者。

translations.literal: He went to the goblet-washing station, stood facing north, inserted his tablet, washed the goblet, wiped it, and handed it to an attendant.
translations.idiomatic: He went to the goblet-washing station, stood facing north, inserted his tablet, washed and wiped the goblet, and handed it to an attendant.

sentences.zh: 執笏，升，詣酒尊所，西向立，執事者以爵授皇太子，搢笏，執爵。

translations.literal: He held his tablet, ascended, went to the wine vessel, stood facing west; an attendant handed the goblet to the crown prince; he inserted his tablet and held the goblet.
translations.idiomatic: He held his tablet, ascended, and went to the wine vessel, standing facing west; an attendant handed him the goblet; he inserted his tablet and held the goblet.

sentences.zh: 執事者舉冪酌酒，皇太子以爵授執事者，詣神位前北向，搢笏，跪。

translations.literal: An attendant raised the cover and poured wine; the crown prince handed the goblet to the attendant, went before the spirit seat facing north, inserted his tablet, and knelt.
translations.idiomatic: An attendant raised the cover and poured wine; the crown prince handed the goblet back, went before the spirit seat facing north, inserted his tablet, and knelt.

sentences.zh: 執事者以爵授皇太子，執爵三祭酒，反爵於坫，執笏，俯伏，興，少立。

translations.literal: An attendant handed the goblet to the crown prince; he held the goblet and thrice poured libation; he returned the goblet to the stand, held his tablet, prostrated himself, rose, and stood briefly.
translations.idiomatic: An attendant handed him the goblet; he thrice poured libation, returned the goblet to the stand, held his tablet, prostrated himself, rose, and stood briefly.

sentences.zh: 次引太祝、舉祝官詣讀祝位東北向，舉祝官跪舉祝版，太祝跪讀祝，訖，置祝於案，俯伏，興。

translations.literal: Next the chief invoker and the prayer-board bearer were led to the prayer-reading station, facing northeast; the prayer-board bearer knelt and raised the prayer board; the chief invoker knelt and read the prayer; when finished, he set the prayer on the table, prostrated himself, and rose.
translations.idiomatic: Next the chief invoker and prayer-board bearer were led to the prayer-reading station, facing northeast; the prayer-board bearer knelt and raised the board; the chief invoker knelt and read the prayer, then set it on the table, prostrated himself, and rose.

sentences.zh: 舉祝官皆卻立北向。

translations.literal: The prayer-board bearers all stepped back and stood facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The prayer-board bearers all stepped back and stood facing north.

sentences.zh: 贊者曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: The announcer said: "Bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: The announcer called: "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 」皇太子就兩拜，降階復位。

translations.literal: The crown prince performed two bows, descended the steps, and returned to his place.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince bowed twice, descended the steps, and returned to his station.

sentences.zh: 舉祝、讀祝官後從，複本位。

translations.literal: The prayer-board bearers and prayer readers followed behind and returned to their places.
translations.idiomatic: The prayer-board bearers and prayer readers followed behind and returned to their stations.

sentences.zh: 禮直官曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol officer said: "Bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol officer called: "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 」在位者皆再拜。

translations.literal: All in their places bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: All in their stations bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 宮闈令納神主於室，贊者曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: The director of palace gates placed the spirit tablet in the chamber; the announcer said: "Bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: The director of palace gates placed the spirit tablet in the chamber. The announcer called: "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 」皆再拜，禮畢，退。

translations.literal: All bowed twice; the rites were complete and they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: All bowed twice; the rites were complete and they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 署令闔廟門，瘞祝於坎，儀物各還所司。

translations.literal: The director closed the temple gate, buried the prayer in the pit, and ceremonial objects were each returned to their offices.
translations.idiomatic: The director closed the temple gate, buried the prayer in the pit, and ceremonial objects were returned to their respective offices.

sentences.zh: 十一年，郊祀前一日朝享，與太廟同日，用登歌樂，行三獻禮，有司攝事。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, on the day before the suburban sacrifice, the court audience offering was performed on the same day as the Grand Ancestral Temple, using elevated song, with the three-presentation rite; the relevant offices performed the sacrifice by proxy.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, on the day before the suburban sacrifice, the court audience offering was performed on the same day as the Grand Ancestral Temple, using elevated song and the three-presentation rite; the responsible offices performed the sacrifice by proxy.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，敕別建昭德皇后影廟于太廟內。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, an edict ordered a separate portrait temple for Empress Zhaode built within the Grand Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, an edict ordered a separate portrait temple for Empress Zhaode built within the Grand Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 有司言：「宜建殿三間，南面一屋三門，垣周以甓，外垣置靈星門一，神廚及西房各三間。

translations.literal: The relevant offices stated: "A hall of three bays should be built, with one structure of three gates to the south, walls all around of brick, one Lingxing Gate on the outer wall, and three bays each for the spirit kitchen and west rooms."
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices stated: "A hall of three bays should be built, with one structure of three gates to the south, brick walls all around, one Lingxing Gate on the outer wall, and three bays each for the spirit kitchen and west rooms."

sentences.zh: 然禮無廟中別建影廟之例，今皇后廟西有隙地，廣三十四步，袤五十四步，可以興建。

translations.literal: However, ritual provides no precedent for building a separate portrait temple within a temple; now west of the empress's temple there is vacant ground thirty-four paces wide and fifty-four paces long, on which construction is possible.
translations.idiomatic: However, ritual provides no precedent for building a separate portrait temple within a temple; west of the empress's temple there is vacant ground thirty-four paces wide and fifty-four paces long, suitable for construction.

sentences.zh: 」制可。

translations.literal: The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 仍于正南別創正門，門以坤儀為名。

translations.literal: A separate main gate was also created due south, named Kunyi.
translations.idiomatic: A separate main gate was also created due south, named Kunyi.

sentences.zh: 仍留舊有便門，遇禘祫祔享由之。

translations.literal: The old convenience gate was retained; on di, xia, and joint-worship offerings passage was through it.
translations.idiomatic: The old convenience gate was retained for use during di, xia, and joint-worship offerings.

sentences.zh: 每歲五享並影廟行禮于正南門出入。

translations.literal: Each year's five offerings and rites at the portrait temple entered and exited through the due-south gate.
translations.idiomatic: Each year's five offerings and rites at the portrait temple used the due-south gate for entry and exit.

sentences.zh: 又於廟外起齋廊房二十三間。

translations.literal: Twenty-three bays of purification corridor rooms were also built outside the temple.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-three bays of purification corridor rooms were also built outside the temple.

sentences.zh: 宣孝太子廟。

translations.literal: Temple of Crown Prince Xiaoxiao
translations.idiomatic: Temple of Crown Prince Xiaoxiao

sentences.zh: 大定二十五年七月，有司奏：「依唐典，故太子置廟，設官屬奉祀。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the twenty-fifth year of Dading, the relevant offices memorialized: "Following Tang precedent, a deceased crown prince should have a temple established and officials appointed to perform worship."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Dading 25, the responsible offices memorialized: "Following Tang precedent, a deceased crown prince should have a temple established and officials appointed to perform worship."

sentences.zh: 擬於法物庫東建殿三間，南垣及外垣皆一屋三間，東西垣各一屋一門，門設九戟。

translations.literal: It was proposed to build a hall of three bays east of the ritual-objects storehouse; the south wall and outer wall each with one structure of three bays; east and west walls each with one structure and one gate; gates to bear nine halberds.
translations.idiomatic: It was proposed to build a hall of three bays east of the ritual-objects storehouse; the south and outer walls each with one structure of three bays; east and west walls each with one structure and one gate; gates to bear nine halberds.

sentences.zh: 齋房、神廚，度地之宜。

translations.literal: Purification rooms and the spirit kitchen were to be placed as the ground permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Purification rooms and the spirit kitchen were to be placed as the ground permitted.

sentences.zh: 」又奉旨：「太子廟既安神主，宜別建影殿。

translations.literal: By imperial command it was also stated: "Since the crown prince's temple will enshrine the spirit tablet, a separate portrait hall should be built."
translations.idiomatic: By imperial command it was also stated: "Since the crown prince's temple will enshrine the spirit tablet, a separate portrait hall should be built."

sentences.zh: 」有司定擬制度，於見建廟稍西中間，限以磚墉，內建影殿三間。

translations.literal: The relevant offices fixed the regulations: slightly west of the middle of the temple then being built, bounded by a brick wall, a portrait hall of three bays was built within.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices fixed the regulations: slightly west of the middle of the temple then being built, bounded by a brick wall, a portrait hall of three bays was built within.

sentences.zh: 南面一屋三門，垣周以甓，無闕角及東西門。

translations.literal: To the south one structure of three gates; walls all around of brick; no corner towers or east and west gates.
translations.idiomatic: To the south one structure of three gates; brick walls all around; no corner towers or east and west gates.

sentences.zh: 外垣正南建三門一，左右翼廊二十間，神廚、齋室各二屋三間，是歲十月，廟成。

translations.literal: On the outer wall due south one triple gate was built; twenty bays of wing corridors left and right; the spirit kitchen and purification rooms each two structures of three bays; in the tenth month of that year the temple was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On the outer wall due south one triple gate was built, with twenty bays of wing corridors left and right; the spirit kitchen and purification rooms each two structures of three bays. In the tenth month of that year the temple was completed.

sentences.zh: 十一日奉安神主，十四日奉遷畫像。

translations.literal: On the eleventh day the spirit tablet was reverently installed; on the fourteenth day the painted portrait was reverently transferred.
translations.idiomatic: On the eleventh day the spirit tablet was ceremonially installed; on the fourteenth day the painted portrait was ceremonially transferred.

sentences.zh: 神主用栗，依唐制諸侯用一尺，刻諡於背。

translations.literal: The spirit tablet was of chestnut wood; following Tang regulation for feudal lords, one foot in size, with the posthumous title carved on the back.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit tablet was of chestnut wood; following Tang regulation for feudal lords, one foot in size, with the posthumous title carved on the back.

sentences.zh: 省部遣官於本廟西南隅面北設幄次，監視製造，於行禮前一日製造訖。

translations.literal: The central ministries dispatched officials to set a curtain enclosure in the southwest corner of the temple, facing north, to supervise manufacture; manufacture was completed on the day before the rites.
translations.idiomatic: The central ministries dispatched officials to set a curtain enclosure in the southwest corner of the temple, facing north, to supervise manufacture, which was completed on the day before the rites.

sentences.zh: 其日晚，奉神主官奉承以箱，覆以帕，捧詣題神主幄中。

translations.literal: That evening, the officer bearing the spirit tablet received it in a case, covered it with a cloth, and bore it to the enclosure for inscribing the spirit tablet.
translations.idiomatic: That evening, the officer bearing the spirit tablet received it in a case, covered it with a cloth, and bore it to the enclosure for inscribing the spirit tablet.

sentences.zh: 次日醜前五刻，題神主官與典儀並禮官詣幄次前，題神主官詣罍洗位，盥手、帨手訖，奉神主官先以香湯奉沐，拭以羅巾。

translations.literal: Before the fifth quarter of the chou hour the next day, the officer inscribing the spirit tablet, the master of ritual, and ritual officials came before the enclosure; the inscribing officer went to the ewer-washing station; when hand-washing and drying were finished, the officer bearing the spirit tablet first bathed it with scented water and wiped it with a silk towel.
translations.idiomatic: Before the fifth quarter of the chou hour the next day, the inscribing officer, master of ritual, and ritual officials came before the enclosure. The inscribing officer went to the ewer-washing station; when hand-washing and drying were finished, the officer bearing the spirit tablet bathed it with scented water and wiped it with a silk towel.

sentences.zh: 題神主官就褥位，題諡號於背雲「宣孝太子神主」，墨書，用光漆模，訖，授奉神主官，承以箱，覆以梅紅羅帕，藉以素羅帕，詣座置於匱，乃下簾帷，侍衛如式。

translations.literal: The inscribing officer took the kneeling mat and inscribed the posthumous title on the back: "Spirit tablet of Crown Prince Xiaoxiao," in ink, using a glossy-lacquer mold; when finished, he handed it to the officer bearing the spirit tablet, who received it in a case, covered it with a plum-red silk cloth laid on a plain silk cloth, went to the seat and placed it in the casket, then lowered curtains and canopies; guards followed the prescribed form.
translations.idiomatic: The inscribing officer took the kneeling mat and inscribed the posthumous title on the back: "Spirit tablet of Crown Prince Xiaoxiao," in ink, using a glossy-lacquer mold. When finished, he handed it to the officer bearing the spirit tablet, who received it in a case covered with plum-red silk over plain silk, placed it in the casket at the seat, lowered curtains and canopies, and posted guards according to prescribed form.

sentences.zh: 俟典儀俯伏，跪請，備腰輿傘扇詣神位。

translations.literal: When the master of ritual prostrated himself and knelt in request, the sedan chair, umbrella, and fans were prepared to go to the spirit seat.
translations.idiomatic: When the master of ritual prostrated himself and knelt in request, the sedan chair, umbrella, and fans were prepared to go to the spirit seat.

sentences.zh: 導引侍衛皆減昭德廟儀。

translations.literal: Guides and guards were all reduced from the rites of Zhaode's temple.
translations.idiomatic: Guides and guards were all reduced from the rites used at Zhaode's temple.

sentences.zh: 祭儀，有司言：「當隨祖廟四時祭享。

translations.literal: For the sacrifice rites, the relevant offices stated: "They should follow the four-season offerings of the ancestral temple."
translations.idiomatic: For the sacrifice rites, the responsible offices stated: "They should follow the four-season offerings of the ancestral temple."

sentences.zh: 初獻于皇孫皇族、亞獻于皇族或五品以下差。

translations.literal: The initial presentation by an imperial grandson of the imperial clan; the secondary presentation by a clansman or someone dispatched from the fifth rank and below.
translations.idiomatic: The initial presentation by an imperial grandson of the imperial clan; the secondary presentation by a clansman or someone dispatched from the fifth rank and below.

sentences.zh: 樂用登歌，今量減用二十五人，其接神用無射宮，升降徹豆則歌夾鐘。

translations.literal: Music used elevated song; now twenty-five performers were used by measured reduction; for receiving the spirit the Wushe mode was used; for ascending, descending, and withdrawing the vessels the Jiazhong mode was sung.
translations.idiomatic: Music used elevated song, now with twenty-five performers by measured reduction; for receiving the spirit the Wushe mode was used; for ascending, descending, and withdrawing the vessels the Jiazhong mode was sung.

sentences.zh: 牲羊、豕各一、籩豆各八，簠簋各二，登鉶各一，其餘祭食亦量減之。

translations.literal: Victims: one sheep and one pig; baskets and vessels eight each; grain vessels two each; offering stands one each; other sacrificial foods were also reduced by measure.
translations.idiomatic: Victims: one sheep and one pig; baskets and vessels eight each; grain vessels two each; offering stands one each; other sacrificial foods were also reduced proportionally.

sentences.zh: 」二十六年十一月一日，奏：「神主廟，牲牢樂縣官給。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eleventh month of the twenty-sixth year, a memorial stated: "For the spirit-tablet temple, victims, music, and palace ensemble shall be supplied by the state."
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eleventh month of the twenty-sixth year, a memorial stated: "For the spirit-tablet temple, victims, music, and palace ensemble shall be supplied by the state."

sentences.zh: 影廟，皇孫奉祀。」

translations.literal: For the portrait temple, imperial grandsons shall perform the worship."
translations.idiomatic: For the portrait temple, imperial grandsons shall perform the worship."
